review_type: third AI agent adjudication of two independent AI annotation passes; not human or clinician IAA

definitions.population: 24 source cases times five fields = 120 field comparisons. Metrics compare original A versus original B, before adjudication.
definitions.supported_value: The first evidence span supplies the value only when state is S.
definitions.normalization: Unicode casefold, collapse whitespace, trim leading/trailing ASCII punctuation and surrounding whitespace. Preserve articles, possessives, wrappers, qualifiers, and internal punctuation. No synonyms, clinical inference, or semantic matching.
definitions.supported_value_denominators: Primary value agreement uses fields marked S by both annotators. The either-S secondary metric treats one-sided S as disagreement. All 120 rows also report state-plus-value agreement; non-S fields agree on this signature exactly when their states agree.
definitions.exact_evidence_set: Order-independent sets of resolved zero-based transcript (start, end-exclusive, exact text) triples. Punctuation, sentence splitting, extra evidence, and different occurrences count as differences. Offset and string representations agree only if they resolve to the same triple.
definitions.null_value_agreement: Null denotes that the both-S value comparison does not apply; it is never silently counted as a supported-value match.

limitations: Synthetic development cohort; no clinician, human, or clinical validity claim.
Annotators share the same rubric and model/task context; independent passes do not imply independent human judgment.
Adjudication necessarily sees both original annotations and is not a third blinded annotation pass.
The rubric knowledge-qualification boundary required a documented adjudicator interpretation applied consistently before inference.
Pollen wording and compound-question answers remain ordinary-language interpretation limits.
Evidence-set and lexical value differences include semantically equivalent span choices; they are reported separately from state disagreements.
No implementation, tests, prior cases, product parser/scorer, or model outputs were used.
